description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin called 'editingblock' that manages the editing mode, data handling, and event firing for the editor's editing area, including mode switching and snapshot management.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current mode object for the editor based on the mode name.

methods.name: addMode
methods.description: Registers a new editing mode with the editor.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Switches the editor to a specified mode, handling data loading and unloading.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Moves focus to the editor's editing area.
